rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and ZIP, matching to a single user before accessing any account data. It located the correct tablet order and provided the tracking number from tool results. For each change (returning the tablet, canceling the charger and the boots+kettle order, and returning the sneakers), the agent stated the exact items and order IDs, asked for explicit confirmation (including a reason for cancellations), and only then executed the appropriate tool calls. All actions were permissible under order statuses (pending orders canceled; delivered items had returns requested). Post-action summaries matched tool outputs (e.g., refunds processed immediately for cancellations; returns set to “return requested” with refund upon completion). No fabricated information, no improper actions, and no writes without confirmation. The conversation remained within the authenticated user’s orders. Therefore, it meets the policy and the pass bar.
